page.overview:
Who is Murakarmi?

Murakarmi is a character in Cars 2. He is a security officer at Haneda Airport in Tokyo.

In Cars 2, Officer Murakarmi is an airport official at Haneda Airport. He works in metal detection, and is seen watching Alex Vandel through the security gates. He is modeled after a box car.

He makes a cameo in Cars 3, when Lightning and Smokey were watching in Smokey's Automotive Service the oldest newspapers how Doc helped McQueen in the races.
